status-duration-immunity: Stun-immune enemy not Stunned but still a valid centre; R004 Stun persists without cap.
order-death-retargeting: All Stun applies precede the first damage (native order); waves pick living centres.

rule.note: Official status guide: Submerged, Death Mark (10% per turn death roll after first turn).

extra.note: R004: Submerged ends on holder action; Death Mark roll unchanged, no cap.

status-duration-immunity: R004: Submerged no timer, ends when the caster next casts (real castSkill); Death Mark grace tick kept, no cap, no death on failed rolls >= 10%.
order-death-retargeting: Submerged applied before the marks (native order); no damage.
mana-economy-extra-turn: Cast spends 11 and passes the turn; low mana and Silence block.
display-description: Chinese '下潜自身，并使 2 名随机敌人陷入死亡标记状态。' asserted.

c1: Self Submerged, 2 random enemies Death Marked. convention:R006-C3

2: CauseDeathMark RandomPrefNotPrevEnemy -> second, distinct while 2+ live. convention:R006-C3
